title: Get Work Orders By Filter
description: Operates on Service Orders, shown in the Zuper client app as "Work Order" (in every industry). Work Orders share the exact same underlying schema and endpoints as Purchase Orders / Material Orders; they're distinguished only by the `purchase_order_type` field (`SERVICE_ORDER` here) and the `/service_orders` route prefix.
